The beast's attack changes all beneficial effects granted on the target to Continuous Damage for 1 turn, and the rider's attack inflicts damage that increases by 15% for each harmful effect granted on the target.

In addition, increases your Attack Speed for 1 turn and decreases the enemy's Defense for 1 turn with each attack. [Automatic Effect]
